html:
Space Poppers is a women- and LGBTQIA+-owned cannabis edible brand known for its THC-infused popcorn, founded by Netflix “Baking Impossible” champions Sara Schonour and Rodolfo Goncalves. BUZZY carries Space Poppers in Brooklyn — here’s the founders’ story and how to shop it.

Shop Space Poppers at BUZZY →

What Is Space Poppers?

Space Poppers is transforming one of the world’s most beloved snacks into an award-winning edible experience. Known for its THC-infused popcorn, the brand offers a playful alternative to traditional edibles, pairing bold flavors with a shareable, resealable format designed for everything from movie nights to social gatherings. In a market filled with gummies and chocolates, Space Poppers stands out by delivering something unexpected: a snack that’s just as fun to eat as it is effective.

Who Founded Space Poppers?

Space Poppers was founded by Netflix Baking Impossible champions Sara Schonour and Rodolfo Goncalves, and co-owned by Sara’s wife, Shantel Schonour. The company combines culinary artistry, engineering, education, and a healthy sense of adventure — and is majority women-owned, with Sara and Shantel leading much of the day-to-day strategy, operations, education, and growth.

Sara Schonour — Co-Founder & CEO

With a background in engineering and lighting design, Sara brings an inventive approach to problem-solving and entrepreneurship. She is a passionate advocate for equity within the cannabis industry and believes deeply in supporting communities that have historically been underrepresented. Space Poppers proudly partners with organizations and initiatives that align with those values, including Queer in Cannabis and other community-focused causes.

Shantel Schonour — Co-Owner & COO

Known internally as the operational engine behind the brand, Shantel oversees education, dispensary success, training, and systems management. A former literacy educator and executive-function coach, she brings structure and clarity to the fast-moving world of cannabis.

Rodolfo Goncalves — Co-Founder & UFO (Unidentified Flavor Officer)

Born in Brazil, Rodolfo immigrated to the United States and built a successful career as an acclaimed cake artist with his own bakery in New York City’s West Village. Today, he leads branding and flavor innovation at Space Poppers, bringing the same creativity and craftsmanship that earned him national recognition as a baker.

How Did Space Poppers Start?

Space Poppers was born from an unlikely partnership between Sara Schonour and Rodolfo Goncalves, who met while competing — and ultimately winning — Netflix’s Baking Impossible. During the competition, the pair became known for tackling ambitious food-engineering challenges, from a functional chocolate light fixture to a life-sized car made primarily from popcorn.

After the show, Sara began exploring the idea of launching a cannabis edible company. While experimenting with different formats, Rodolfo suggested popcorn — a snack Sara already loved and one that offered endless possibilities for flavor and texture. As they shared samples with friends and brought batches to parties, people weren’t just enjoying the product — they were asking where they could buy it. That enthusiasm helped launch what would eventually become one of New York’s most distinctive edible brands.

Built by Queer and Immigrant Founders

Space Poppers was founded by people who understand what it means to forge your own path. Built by members of the queer and immigrant communities, the company views diversity, inclusion, and equity not as marketing messages but as everyday responsibilities.

“Our identities are not side notes to our journey — they are the foundation of everything we build.”

That perspective shapes how the company hires, how it leads, how it partners with others, and how it shows up in the cannabis community.

What Makes Space Poppers Different?

While Space Poppers is known for award-winning flavors and an innovative format, the founders believe cannabis serves a larger purpose.

“Cannabis, like popcorn, is meant to be shared.”

Their resealable popcorn format naturally encourages conversation, sharing, and connection — whether you’re microdosing with a few kernels or settling in for a bigger experience.

Where to Buy Space Poppers in Brooklyn

BUZZY is proud to carry Space Poppers on our shelves in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn. As a women-owned and LGBTQIA+-owned business, Space Poppers is helping create a more diverse and representative cannabis industry while delivering one of the most unique edible experiences around. Stop by BUZZY to pick up a bag, or check our menu to see current flavors in stock.

FAQ

What is Space Poppers?

Space Poppers is a women- and LGBTQIA+-owned cannabis brand that makes THC-infused popcorn, offering a shareable, flavor-forward alternative to traditional gummies and chocolates.

Who founded Space Poppers?

Sara Schonour and Rodolfo Goncalves, who met and won Netflix’s Baking Impossible, founded the company; Sara’s wife Shantel Schonour co-owns and runs day-to-day operations.

Where can I buy Space Poppers in Brooklyn?

Space Poppers is available at BUZZY in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn — check our menu for current flavors in stock.

Is Space Poppers just for Pride Month?

No — while BUZZY spotlighted Space Poppers during Pride, the brand is carried on our shelves year-round.
